shapeSummary: Solid cylindrical wheel, 32 mm diameter and 16 mm wide. The axis runs along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0, with the wheel center at Y=16 so the bottom sits at Y=0. A hexagonal through-bore with 8 mm across flats runs along the axis.
warnings: The 16 mm width is inferred from image proportions, not stated in the product data.
The 32 mm diameter and 8 mm bore come from unverified product data.
The 8 mm bore is modeled as a hexagon with 8 mm across flats, treating 8 mm as the nominal size.
The spoke cutouts on the faces are omitted because their geometry is uncertain.
The raised tread pips are omitted, so the tread is a plain cylinder.
The plastic core and silicone rim are merged into one solid.
The text on the wheel (goBILDA.com) is not modeled.
